_comment: Shirazi AI provider registry — WIRED in Phase 4 (core/providers/registry.py). The chain is tried left to right: primary → fallback → offline leg. Keys are resolved as: environment variable (key_env) first, then config/api_keys.json (key_config) — NEVER commit real keys here.
_tiers: Tier labels are honest cost labels: 'Local (Free)' = runs on this machine, no key, no quota. 'Free API Tier' = vendor free tier: keyed, QUOTA-LIMITED and rate-limited — never unlimited. 'Optional Paid Provider' = needs the user's own paid key.

gemini.note: Primary today: Gemini Live voice session (main.py ShiraziLive) + one-shot text ladder (core/gemini.py). 3.x leads; 2.5 pins are DEPRECATED fallbacks — Google retires Gemini 2.5 REST on 2026-10-16.

gemini_live.note: Voice path. Phase 4: interface + config only — the session lifecycle is implemented by main.py ShiraziLive (see core/providers/gemini_live.py, documented limitation).

groq.note: Reserved slot for a future provider (see core/providers/future.py for the extension hook). Disabled until registered.

ollama.note: Offline leg: fully local, keyless, no quota. Needs the model pulled locally (ollama pull llama3.2). Used today by code_helper/dev_agent via core/llm_client.py.

openrouter.note: Fallback chain leg: OpenRouter ':free' endpoints only (free_only=true — a non-:free model id is refused, never billed). Rate/quota limited. Add model ids from openrouter.ai/models that end in ':free' to enable. Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY or api_keys.json entry.
